name: Md. Akram Hossain
title: Lecturer in CSE & AI/NLP Researcher
department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering & CSIT
bio: I am currently a Lecturer at the Department of Computer Science and Engineering at Shanto-Mariam University of Creative Technology (SMUCT). Prior to joining SMUCT, I served as an Adjunct Lecturer at BGC Trust University Bangladesh.

Previously, I was a research fellow at the Data Science Research Group (CSECU-DSG) at the University of Chittagong under the supervision of Professor Abu Nowshed Chy. I earned my B.Sc. in Engineering in Computer Science and Engineering from the University of Chittagong.
My primary research interests encompass Machine Learning and Natural Language Processing, focusing on developing robust, reliable, and intelligent computational models for real-world applications.

currentProjects.title: AI-Based Hearing Aid System Development
currentProjects.description: Developing an embedded system for a cognitively-inspired hearing aid integrating NLP and speech enhancement for real-time audio processing on edge devices.
